title: Valid Sudoku
goal: Solve Valid Sudoku: Check row, column and box membership independently for every filled Sudoku cell.
strategy: Check row, column and box membership independently for every filled Sudoku cell.
edgeCases: Empty cells are ignored; a valid partial board is not necessarily a solved or solvable board.

checks.condition: v in rows[r] or v in cols[c] or v in boxes[b]

inputRules: board must be an array of 9 rows
each row must be an array of 9 cells
